title.th: ประกาศตามมาตรา 4(1)(a)(i)

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 4(1)(a)(i))
Notification under Section 4(1)(a)(i)
N 13
G.N. No. S 301/1998
REVISED EDITION 2000
(31st January 2000)
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 4(1)(a)(i) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have omitted the Government Loans (Conversion and Miscellaneous Provisions) Act (Chapter 120) from the revised edition of Acts.
